d:
A face pack, chana chur and conversations about s*x between siblings.
Terribly Tiny Talkies is a storytelling collective which brings together distinctive and talented filmmakers from across the country to craft thematic short films.
TTT endures saving the fading art of the narrative, one frame at a time.
Terribly Tiny Talkies is part of Terribly Tiny Tales - India's largest and most celebrated storytelling platform.
Directed by hardik & gaura
Written by Hardik Nagar
Starring: Shiv Tandon & Nitya Mathur
DoP & Editor: Chanda Gauranga
